tool_args.rationale: Fit the authorized gradient-inhibited saturating siphon with a signed square-root branch over the full fallback parameter bounds. The added wide-gradient observations distinguish vmax from rho; fresh confirmation will test the resulting law.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its two gradient levels resolve the pilot's vmax–rho collinearity.
The provided siphon law has no time-dependent parameters to identify, and the existing rows span drive and gradient.
Neither supplied mechanism accounts for the observed strong gradient dependence.
